bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$cid" >/dev/null
state="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')"
test "$state" = true || exit 61
count="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)"
test "$count" -eq 1 || exit 62
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq 'stickerLandingPanel' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs || exit 63
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq 'uniqueAcknowledgedAppend' /opt/videobot/src/stickers/packRegistration.mjs || exit 64
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq '✅ 登録できました！' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 65
docker logs --tail 200 "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' || exit 66
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_RUNTIME_READBACK=PASS\nPOLL_CONTAINER_COUNT=%s\nSTICKER_RETURN=ACTIVE\nAPPEND_RECEIPT=ACTIVE\nSUCCESS_UI=ACTIVE\n' "$count"
